gloss: children (as a blessing); the gift of children

definitions.gloss: children as a treasure or blessing; the gift of children
definitions.explanation: A warm expression viewing children as precious treasures or blessings. Often used when talking about being blessed with children. Composed of 子 (child) + 宝 (treasure).

examples.japanese: {子宝|こだから}に{恵|めぐ}まれた。
{子宝|こだから}に{恵|めぐ}まれるよう{神社|じんじゃ}にお{参|まい}りした。
examples.english: We visited a shrine to pray for the blessing of children.

examples.japanese: {昔|むかし}から「{子|こ}は{宝|たから}」と{言|い}われるように、{子宝|こだから}は{何|なに}にも{代|か}えがたい。
examples.english: As the saying goes, 'children are treasures' — the gift of children is irreplaceable.

notes:
USAGE:
{子宝|こだから} expresses the traditional Japanese view that children are precious blessings. The most common usage is the set phrase {子宝|こだから}に{恵|めぐ}まれる (to be blessed with children).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {子宝|こだから}に{恵|めぐ}まれる (to be blessed with children)
- {子宝|こだから}{祈願|きがん} (praying for children)
- {子宝|こだから}の{湯|ゆ} (hot spring said to promote fertility)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Many shrines and temples in Japan are known for {子宝|こだから}{祈願|きがん} (fertility prayers). Certain hot springs ({温泉|おんせん}) are also traditionally associated with promoting fertility.
